# CANDIDATE: REMOVE_REQUIRE_BEARISH_FILL_BAR_REVAL

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The REQUIRE_BEARISH_FILL_BAR_REVAL gate currently suppresses a net-winner set of bear trades (+$917 IS) under the current engine, contradicting its original intent to block losing bearish entries. Removing the gate is expected to recover this suppressed edge without harming anchor days.

## Mechanism

The gate blocks entries when the fill bar is not bearish (i.e., the bar that fills the order does not close below its open). Under the current real-fills + managed-exit engine, this condition no longer aligns with losing trades; instead it filters out net-winning bearish entries. The proposal is to set `require_bearish_fill_bar` to false (Bold) to disable the gate.
